bef4ecdcd242c471d1be23a7224454df3266b349.sourceText: 源码先以 `ceil((angle_max-angle_min)/angle_increment)` 建数组，再计算下标。当前实现没有检查下标是否越界，而角度上界允许通过；当角域与增量恰好形成整数分格时，上界点存在越界路径。当前近似整圈设置得到720项，不能据此证明其他角度组合的边界安全；该缺口尚无运行触发记录。
bef4ecdcd242c471d1be23a7224454df3266b349.translatedText: The source code first builds an array with `ceil((angle_max-angle_min)/angle_increment)`, then computes the index\. The current implementation does not check whether the index is out of bounds, while the upper bound of the angle is allowed to pass; when the angular domain and the increment exactly form an integer partition, the upper bound point has an out\-of\-bounds path\. The current approximate full\-circle setting yields 720 entries, and this cannot be used to prove the boundary safety of other angle combinations; this gap has no runtime trigger record yet\.
